outgoingFlows.description: New exposures based on contact between susceptible and infectious individuals; rate is c*S*I/N where c is the daily contact rate
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate epsilon (inverse of incubation period)
Recovery or removal (isolation) of infectious individuals at rate r (inverse of average infectious period, proxied by time from onset to case report)

parameters.name: incubation_period
parameters.description: Average incubation period, time spent exposed but not yet infectious (95% CI 4.1–7.0 days); epsilon = 1/5.2

parameters.name: onset_to_first_medical_visit
parameters.description: Average days from symptom onset to first medical visit and isolation (95% CI 4.3–7.5 days); used to derive daily contact rate c = R0 / 5.8

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Removal/recovery rate, equal to inverse of average infectious period proxied by median time from illness onset to reported case; decreased from 12 days early in outbreak to 3 days in early February due to improved case identification

parameters.name: epsilon
parameters.description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious (1/5.2 days)

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Daily contact rate calculated as R0 divided by average days from onset to first medical visit (5.8 days), weighted by relative level of daily contact from Baidu movement data

parameters.name: initial_infected
parameters.description: Number of initially infected people seeded in Wuhan on December 1, 2019

parameters.name: simulation_runs
parameters.description: Number of stochastic simulation runs performed
